title: Clean invoice, exact PO match
why: Text PDF, explicit PO, every line matches PO price and quantity, maths and tax reconcile.

title: Split PO — partial invoice #2
why: PO-26-1002 already has $30,000 invoiced. This $12,000 partial fits inside the $48,000 PO.

title: Split PO — cumulative over-billing
why: Each invoice looks fine alone, but cumulative billing on PO-26-1002 now exceeds the PO value.

title: Scanned image, no PO number
why: Image-only PDF (needs vision). No PO printed — the process must infer the PO from vendor, amount and route.

title: Disguised duplicate
why: 'APX/2026/388' is the already-paid 'APX-2026-0388' with different formatting. Exact-match checks miss it.

title: Missing invoice # and total that doesn't add up
why: No invoice number. Prices say tax-inclusive yet tax is added again, and the printed total matches neither.

title: Unplanned charge above PO
why: Two lines match the PO; an extra $640 overage line is not on the PO (5.7% over expected).

title: Remit-to bank account changed
why: Everything matches except the bank account differs from the vendor master — classic payment-fraud pattern.

title: Vendor not in master file
why: Vendor is not approved, PO number does not exist, urgent wire request.
